description: Bounded deterministic profile of Király's local 3/2-approximation for maximum stable matching with ties and incomplete lists.

source.title: Simpler Approximation for Stable Marriage
source.reference: Encyclopedia of Algorithms, DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-2864-4_676; summarizes Király 2013
source.algorithm_attribution: Király's linear-time local Deferred Acceptance variation for MAX-SMTI, with a 3/2 approximation guarantee
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; no book prose or source code copied

input.encoding: [men, women, men_rank[men][women] row-major, women_rank[women][men] row-major]; -1 means unacceptable; nonnegative values are weak-order ranks, where lower is preferred and equal values are tied
input.acceptability_rule: A man-woman pair must be acceptable to both sides or to neither side.
input.tie_rule: Equal nonnegative ranks represent a tie; rank gaps are permitted.

output.encoding: one woman ID per man, or -1 if unmatched, in man-ID order

workspace.meaning: Bounded rank tables, acceptable-pair/live-list state, matching, participant statuses, and staged result for at most six men and six women.

contract.selection_rule: Repeatedly activate the lowest-ID unmatched man who is not an old bachelor; he proposes to his favorite live acceptable woman, with maiden-before-engaged preference within an equal rank and then lower woman ID.
contract.woman_rule: An engaged woman is flighty exactly when her fiancé is an uncertain lad. A flighty woman prefers any certain suitor to her uncertain fiancé regardless of original rank. Otherwise she compares weak rank, then bachelor over lad within a tie, then lower man ID.
contract.uncertainty_rule: An engaged lad is uncertain when a live woman has a strictly better weak-order rank than his fiancé, or is maiden while tied with his engaged fiancé. ID tie-breaking does not make an indifferent woman a strict preference for uncertainty.
contract.rejection_rule: A rejected proposer deletes that woman. A displaced uncertain lad keeps the woman who rejected him; a displaced certain lad or bachelor deletes her.
contract.exhaustion_rule: A lad whose live list empties becomes a bachelor, restores his original acceptable list, and reactivates. A bachelor whose restored list empties becomes an inactive old bachelor.
contract.determinism: Every otherwise unresolved tie is broken by lower participant ID.
